import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import os

# 设置工作目录
work_dir = "⟨workdir⟩"
os.chdir(work_dir)

# 连接SQLite数据库
db_path = "dacomp-025.sqlite"

# 执行窗口函数查询
query = """
SELECT *,
       RANK()         OVER (ORDER BY "Sales volume (kg)") AS r,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Sales volume (kg)") AS pr,
       NTILE(100)     OVER (ORDER BY "Sales volume (kg)") AS pct_bucket
  FROM sales_records
"""

# 将查询结果加载到DataFrame中

# 关闭数据库连接

# 显示结果的前几行

# 保存完整的结果到CSV文件以供下游分析
output_file = "sales_ranked_full.csv"
ranked_data.to_csv(output_file, index=False)

# 显示数据的基本信息
print("\n数据类型信息:")
print(ranked_data.info())
```
